% The Markov chain of Roulette's motivating.rkt (the paper's Figure 2),
% ported to ProbLog: x(0) ~ flip 0.1, and after step T, x(T + 1) is flip
% 0.2 (a) where x(T) holds and flip 0.3 (b) where it does not, for $1

steps(3000).

step(T1) :- step(T), steps(N), T1 = T + 1, T1 < N.
0.2::a(T) :- step(T).
0.3::b(T) :- step(T).
0.1::x(0).
x(T1) :- step(T), T1 = T + 1, x(T), a(T).
x(T1) :- step(T), T1 = T + 1, \+x(T), b(T).
query(x(3000)).

Base.Experimental.@compiler_options compile=min optimize=0 infer=false

observe!(path, c) = (EV[] = EV[] & (!path | c); true)

    k = min(n, W)
    DistUInt{W}(vcat(fill(false, k), x.bits[1:W - k]))

components(x) = Any[x]

function warmup()
    a = flip(0.7)
    x = discrete(DistUInt{2}, [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4])
    y = uniform(DistUInt{3}, 1, 6)
    z = ifelse(a, x + DistUInt{2}(1), x - DistUInt{2}(1))
    t = ifelse(flip(0.4), (a, z), (!a, x * x))
    e = prob_equals(z, DistUInt{2}(2)) | (x < z) | xor(a, flip(0.2))
    pr(flip(0.7))

    nothing

     x3_step = flip(0.2)

     x4_step = flip(0.3)
    end
    x5_step = x2_x === true ? x3_step : x2_x === false ? x4_step : ifelse(x2_x, x3_step, x4_step)
    return x5_step
end

    x7_result = x6_x0
    for _ in 1:10000
     x7_result = d_step(true, x7_result)
    end
    return x7_result

    if x isa AnyBool
        println("alea ", k, " true ", d[true])
        println("alea ", k, " false ", d[false])
    else
        for v in 0:(2^width(x) - 1)
            println("alea ", k, " ", v, " ", d[v])
        end
    end
end

    stats = @timed begin
        comps = components(dice_main())
        dists = pr(comps...; evidence = EV[])
        (comps, length(comps) == 1 ? [dists] : dists)
    end
    comps, dists = stats.value

    end
    println("alea_seconds ", stats.time)
    println("alea_compile_seconds ", get(stats, :compile_time, NaN))

schedule(task)
wait(task)

;; benchmark/modular/motivating.rkt of the Roulette artifact (Zenodo
;; 10.5281/zenodo.15253254), its last line changed to print P(x(N)) in
;; full (print.rkt).
(require "print.rkt")

(define (main n)
  (let go ([n n])
    (cond
      [(zero? n) (flip 0.1)]
      [else
       (define x (flip 0.2))
       (define y (flip 0.3))
       (if (go (sub1 n)) x y)])))

(define SIZE (string->number (vector-ref (current-command-line-arguments) 0)))
(define result (time (query (main SIZE))))
(statement (emit (format "x(~a)" SIZE) (result #t) #t))
